senses.en: A small haven. See Hithe. I () I, the ninth letter of the English alphabet, takes its form from the Phoenician, through the Latin and the Greek. The Phoenician letter was probably of Egyptian origin. Its original value was nearly the same as that of the Italian I, or long e as in mete. Etymologically I is most closely related to e, y, j, g; as in dint, dent, beverage, L. bibere; E. kin, AS. cynn; E. thin, AS. /ynne; E. dominion, donjon, dungeon.
senses.zh: 一个小天堂,见Hithe. I () I,英文字母表的第九个字母,其形式来自腓尼基语,通过拉丁语和希腊语;腓尼基语字母可能来自埃及语,其原始价值与意大利语的几乎相同,或者说远在米特语中。大意学上,我与e,y,j,g最密切相关;如dint,dent,berage,L. bibere;E. kin,AS.cynn;E. share,AS./ynne;E. policy,don,Donjon, jaune。
